name: Cesanese del Piglio
shape: ARSIAL wine zones for Regione Lazio
terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata e Garantita, Italy's top tier. Stricter than DOC, and given only to wines that have been DOC for at least seven years.

blurb.text: A Lazio DOCG centered on Piglio, with Anagni, Paliano and two other communes. Its rules require at least 90% Cesanese d'Affile and/or Cesanese Comune, both red grapes.
